text.tspan: Displays name, id, description, and firmware.
• numeric updates commit on Enter or blur
• boolean update commits on selection change
• unchanged values never send a PUT
• failure shows API detail and restores last valid value
Presentation, navigation, typed form state, user interaction,
and request-result feedback. Components do not know
